visual.observation: A Google AdWords page visibly offers an ad credit: "Get your Rs.2000 in ad credit" and shows an email-address field, reCAPTCHA, and a "GET OFFER NOW" button.

visual.potential_relevance: A stated monetary credit is linked to entering an email address and selecting an offer button, which is a reward-and-request relationship relevant for conditional review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the offer was current, genuine, available to the viewer, or whether any email address or payment was submitted.

visual.observation: A closing title states, "Within 24 hours campaign will get approved by google and then you can run your campaign."
visual.context: The statement appears as promotional or instructional overlay text following screens showing Google AdWords campaign setup.
visual.potential_relevance: The text presents a specific approval timeframe and a resulting ability to run the campaign, making a concrete outcome claim associated with the campaign-creation process.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show who makes the claim, whether approval occurred, what conditions apply, or whether the campaign was actually submitted.
